shots.title: Prune stale never-heartbeated sessions before collision checks (#502)
shots.notes: Collision checks now filter sessions whose heartbeat is older than `STALE_SESSION_THRESHOLD_MS`, even if the store returns them after pruning.

shots.title: Allow remote-only and read-only gh/git commands through session-collision guard (#502)

hazards.description: Security review found the first git allowlist was too broad for `git branch` and `git remote`; a follow-up commit narrowed those subcommands and added regressions.

shots.notes: The guard now bypasses collision state for single-segment `gh pr view/checks/status/list/merge` and safe git status/log/diff/show/rev-parse/fetch/ls-remote/branch/remote forms.

shots.title: Expose guard-exempt stale-session clear path for collision recovery (#502)
shots.notes: Collision denial text now points stale-session recovery at `slope session prune` as well as targeted `slope session end --session-id=<id>`.

shots.title: Add session-collision guard regressions for stale sessions and remote commands (#502)
shots.notes: Added regressions for stale returned sessions, remote gh PR merge, read-only git commands, `git -C` status, blocked git checkout, blocked branch deletion, and blocked remote config mutation.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite still emits legacy temp-repo stderr noise, but all tests passed.

training.description: Guard allowlists must be exact when a subcommand can both read and mutate state.
training.outcome: `git branch` and `git remote` now allow only narrow read-safe forms instead of broad subcommand matches.

training.description: Collision recovery can be local-state strict while allowing remote PR completion.
training.outcome: `gh pr merge` no longer requires clearing unrelated local sessions, while chained commands still fall through to the normal collision guard.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/guards/worktree-check.test.ts tests/cli/guards/worktree-check-integration.test.ts` passed: 48 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 228 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3610 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Useful and a little sharp-edged. The core fix was small, but the security review caught why broad command allowlists are a trap.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When exempting commands from a guard, classify by the exact safe form, not just the top-level subcommand.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: `git branch -D feature -v` could have passed an `includes('-v')` check even though it mutates refs.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S141 can build on a less obstructive collision guard and focus on workflow state resync.

bunker_locations: Do not allow a whole git subcommand family when some forms mutate local refs or config.
If a guard bypass exits before opening the store, tests should assert the store was not touched.
Review-required guard changes deserve a hostile pass over allowed command shapes before closeout.
yardage_book_updates: worktree-check now filters stale returned sessions by heartbeat age during collision detection.
worktree-check now allows single-segment remote/read-only gh/git commands before session-collision lookup.
worktree-check denial text now recommends `slope session prune` for stale collision recovery.
git branch and git remote collision bypasses are exact-form allowlists, not broad subcommand allowlists.
course_management_notes: Validation passed: focused guard tests, `corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, `corepack pnpm test`, and `slope roadmap validate`.
